links.outcome: SMOG readability of chatbot responses to microtia patient questions
links.effect: Average SMOG 15.93 (SD=1.94), undergraduate reading level; OpenEvidence worst at 18.06, ChatGPT 16.32, Gemini 14.73, DeepSeek 14.63.
links.quote: Overall, the average DISCERN and SMOG scores across all platforms were 32.19 (SD=4.43) and 15.93 (SD=1.94), respectively, indicating a good quality and an undergraduate reading level.

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient education responses versus appropriate user reading level
links.effect: Mean SMOG 15.93 across platforms (undergraduate level); all four platforms exceeded typical patient reading levels, OpenEvidence highest at 18.06.
links.quote: OpenEvidence had the worst readability (M=18.06, SD=1.12), followed by ChatGPT (M=16.32, SD=1.41).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots for patient education questions on microtia, assessing reliability (DISCERN) and readability (SMOG) without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
